title: Effort Reporting Compliance Extraction — UDM Output
description: JSON contract for effort-reporting and personnel-compliance requirements distilled from a federal award document. Produces award-identifying scalars, an effort-reporting cadence, PI commitments, a per-person key-personnel table, cost-shared effort, governing regulation, record-retention period, and referenced governing documents. UDM-aligned to Award, Personnel, Effort, ProjectRole, CostShare, and Terms.

award_number.description: Federal Award Identification Number as printed on the award. Resolves to UDM Award.Award_Number.

pi_name.description: Principal Investigator full name. Resolves to UDM Personnel.First_Name + Personnel.Last_Name.

project_title.description: Full project title as stated in the award. Resolves to UDM Award.Award_Title.

reporting_frequency.description: Cadence at which effort must be certified. Distinct from the FFR submission cadence.

certification_deadline.description: Deadline for effort certification after each reporting period end. Quote day-counts verbatim.

certification_method.description: Effort certification method per 2 CFR 200.430(i). Resolves to UDM Effort.Certification_Method.

pi_committed_effort.description: PI committed effort using the sponsor's exact phrasing (e.g., '2.0 summer months', '25% academic year'). Resolves to UDM Effort.Committed_Percent.

pi_person_months.description: PI committed effort expressed as person-months when the document provides it (e.g., '2.0'). Resolves to UDM Effort.Committed_Person_Months.

key_personnel_commitments.description: Per-person key-personnel commitments. Each row covers one named individual. Resolves to UDM Effort rows.

role.description: Project role (e.g., 'PI', 'Co-PI', 'Senior Personnel'). Resolves to UDM ProjectRole.

committed_effort.description: Committed effort using the sponsor's exact phrasing.

person_months.description: Effort expressed in person-months when the document provides it.

cost_shared_effort.description: Cost-shared portion of the commitment, when separately documented.

notes.description: Optional clarifying note (e.g., conditional effort, ceiling, dependent on enrollment).

cost_shared_effort.description: Total cost-shared effort obligations across the award. Resolves to UDM CostShare.Committed_Amount.

record_retention.description: Record retention period requirement (e.g., '3 years', 'per sponsor requirements'). Resolves to UDM Terms.Record_Retention_Years.

referenced_documents.description: Referenced governing documents (RTCs, CA-FATC, agency policy statements). Empty array when none are stated.
